name: safe-ledger
description: Free, offline and portable encrypted information vault

scripts.start: npm run prepare:icons && npm run prepare:renderer && electron .
scripts.test:regression: npm run prepare:renderer && node scripts/regression-tests.js && node scripts/crypto-v3-tests.js && node scripts/v2-only-crypto-regression-tests.js && node scripts/ui-regression-tests.js && node scripts/edit-grid-regression-tests.js && node scripts/brute-force-regression-tests.js && node scripts/lockout-regression-tests.js && node scripts/style-consolidation-regression-tests.js && node scripts/runtime-hardening-regression-tests.js && node scripts/cleanup-regression-tests.js && node scripts/sandbox-regression-tests.js && node scripts/atomic-file-regression-tests.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:icons && npm run prepare:renderer && electron-builder --win portable --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:icons && npm run prepare:renderer && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run prepare:icons && npm run prepare:renderer && electron-builder --dir --publish never

author: SafeLedger contributors
